interpretation: The global weight-norm projection is geometrically stable but over-constrains every layer, scaling the beta-0.5 coordinate vector by approximately one half.
The projected direction retains weak benefit on three of four held-out windows and beats fresh88 everywhere, but fails the unchanged weight-shear and recovery gates.
The raw finite-CE gain therefore depends on preserving normal safe-regime magnitude. Stabilization must be inactive in that regime and activate only when map conditioning becomes unsafe.
The prior functional-shear radius plan preregistered maximum condition number 1.01 before the training failure was observed; reuse that geometric bound rather than tune a threshold from this result.

authorization.next_action: Implement uniform direction-preserving coordinate scaling only when the conservative composed shear condition bound exceeds 1.01; require the original finite-CE gates and a separate 25-update stability gate.
